deep_read.description: Enviar mensaje directo al anunciante de Talent Ferry1 Abdulrahman Khamis Abdulrahman Khamis Investor | Board-Level Capital Partner | Technology & Consumer Growth Backer Company Description Talent Ferry1 is a growing organization focused on connecting skilled professionals with organizations that need specialized expertise. The company values accuracy, clarity, and cultural awareness in all forms of communication. Talent Ferry1 supports remote collaboration and uses modern tools to enable efficient workflows across time zones. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, improve processes, and develop their skills. The organization promotes an inclusive, respectful work environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a Translator. The Translator will be responsible for translating written materials between designated source and target languages while preserving meaning, tone, and style. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing and interpreting source texts, conducting terminology research, and ensuring consistent use of glossaries and style guides. The role involves collaborating with project managers and other language professionals, revising and editing translated content, and meeting project deadlines. The Translator will also be expected to perform quality checks on translations, maintain confidentiality of all materials, and use translation and productivity tools to optimize workflow. Qualifications Strong proficiency in at least two languages, including excellent reading, writing, and comprehension skills. Demonstrated experience in translation, localization, and adaptation of content for different audiences and cultures. Ability to research terminology and subject matter, and to apply style guides and glossaries consistently. Solid skills in editing, proofreading, and quality assurance for translated documents. Comfort with using translation software, productivity tools, and common office applications. Effective communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Bachelor’s degree in Linguistics, Translation, Languages, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Prior experience working remotely, with strong self-organization and time management skills. Experience translating technical, legal, medical, or marketing content is a plus.
